items.title: Visa Targets Secure AI Agent Payments Through Expanded Industry Partnership
items.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) announced on Tuesday that it expanded its Agentic Ready program to include merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers and commerce platforms, helping them prepare for transactions initiated by AI agents. The initiative, part of Visa Intelligent Commerce, launched with more than 140 participants, including Adyen, Antom, Billtrust, Checkout.com, Fiserv, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe. items.title: Anthropic Is Going Public Into a Shaky Market. Here’s How Past Mega IPOs Fared in Similar Conditions.
items.summary: Visa and Facebook went public into chaos and rewarded patient owners, while Alibaba debuted in calm markets and stalled. Before Anthropic's Nasdaq debut, the real test may be which of these paths its unusual structure resembles.
